description: This file is a shell script containing tests for the 'git mergetool' functionality. It sets up various git repositories, configurations, and scenarios to validate the behavior of merge tools within Git, including custom tools, GUI tools, conflict resolutions, submodules, and various configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a successful test scenario with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the following command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or unsets git configuration parameters for testing.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository for testing.

methods.description: Searches within files for given patterns.
